messages:
marta: Kicking off a progressive traffic shift for llm-v2-qat (int8). Before I start the ramp, can we lock the gating criteria?

arjun: quick baseline numbers?

marta: baseline fp16 v2 on our standard eval: p95 latency=210ms, gen_tps=120, pass@1=0.873. quant-int8 candidate: p95=180ms, gen_tps=140, pass@1=0.861 (~-1.4%).

samir: that perf delta looks promising. Suggested automatic rollback triggers: accuracy drop >2.0% (relative) over 30m OR hallucination rate increase >5 percentage points OR error_rate >0.3% sustained for 10m OR latency_p95 >1.25x baseline for 15m.

liz: +1 to those. Proposed ramp schedule: 1% (15m smoke) -> 5% (30m) -> 20% (1h) -> 60% (2h) -> 100% (4h). Stop-and-investigate at each gate.

marta: for regulated tenants, make the gate stricter: require pass@1 loss <1.0% AND hallucination delta <2pp at each stage.

qa-bot: Note: A/B runner will sample 10k requests per stage and report stratified metrics (docs/code/chat). Job id 20260320-AB-01 scheduled.

nora: add cost check: token-cost-per-response must not increase by >5% vs baseline. If cost goes up, roll back. Also ensure fallback route is fp16 v2 (not v1).

arjun: also watch OOD slices. If any slice (docs/code/chat) shows >3% relative drop in pass@1, pause ramp.

samir: telemetry safety bits: abort if telemetry missing >2m or if any external alert (pagerduty) fires against inference SLOs.

marta: putting config in one place so rollout-bot can enforce it:
```
{
  "ramp_pct": [1,5,20,60,100],
  "soak_mins": [15,30,60,120,240],
  "rollback": {
    "accuracy_pct_drop": 2.0,
    "hallucination_pp_change": 5.0,
    "error_rate_pct": 0.3,
    "latency_multiplier": 1.25
  },
  "stratified_eval": ["docs","code","chat"],
  "cost_delta_pct_max": 5.0
}
```

liz: minor tweak: make the first smoke 1% for 15m but require a quick manual thumbs-up if pass@1 loss >1% and <2% (human-in-the-loop).

samir: agree. auto-rollback only if breach >= the thresholds. If breach in between (1%-2%) then alert on-call and pause.

rollout-bot: Received rollout config. Canary id cb-1784507890. Starting at 1% -> schedule to 5% in 15 minutes. Will publish diffs to #eng-ml-dashboard every 5m.

marta: I'll watch the dashboard and the A/B report. If I see hallucination uptick, I'll pause and run targeted evals.

arjun: I'll keep an eye on the OOD slices and cost delta. Ping me for immediate rollback.

rollout-bot: Reminder: automated rollback will trigger within ~60s of detecting a breach of the configured thresholds.

marta: thanks all. first stage started. :thumbsup:

qa-bot: A/B run started, sampling live traffic. First 5m window will show near-term diffs.

nora: FYI I pushed a quick quant-profile tweak to reduce hallucination on long-form prompts; if we see improvements, we can continue ramping.

samir: good. let's reconvene after 5m and 30m windows to decide next actions.

rollout-bot: Update: 1% stage healthy at 15m. No thresholds breached. Scheduled ramp to 5% now."
